user.title: New TTS fallback chain
user.description: The chain provides its own TTS entity. It asks the TTS services one after another and uses the first one that works. You define the stages in the next step.

data.name: Name
data.quota_cooldown: Pause after a quota / rate limit error (429)

data_description.name: Also used for the entity ID, e.g. tts.tts_fallback_kette.
data_description.language: Language used when the caller does not specify one.
data_description.timeout: If a stage has not delivered audio after this time, the next stage is started as well. The slow stage keeps running and the first finished audio is used. A timeout is not an error and never pauses a stage. Can be overridden per stage.
data_description.max_wait: If no stage delivered audio by then, the announcement is aborted.
data_description.error_cooldown: How long a stage is skipped after an error (e.g. 503). Timeouts never pause a stage. 0 = never skip.
data_description.quota_cooldown: How long a stage is skipped when its quota is used up (e.g. Gemini free tier). 0 = never skip.

stage_entity.title: Stage {stage}: choose TTS service

stage_options.title: Stage {stage}: {entity}
stage_options.description:
Optional settings for `{entity_id}`. Leave empty to use the defaults of the service.

Options supported by the service: {options}

data_description.voice: E.g. Callirrhoe for Google Gemini or Katja for Home Assistant Cloud. You can also type a voice ID.
data_description.language: Only set this if this stage should always use a specific language.
data_description.timeout: Leave empty for the default ({default_timeout} s). Choose a longer value for a slow but reliable stage (e.g. a paid Gemini key).
data_description.extra_options: Additional TTS options of the service, e.g. `audio_output: mp3`.

error.duplicate_stage: This TTS entity is already part of the chain.
error.own_entity: A fallback chain can not be used as a stage itself.
error.voice_not_supported: This TTS service does not support choosing a voice.
error.language_not_supported: This TTS service does not support this language.
error.invalid_extra_options: The extra options must be an object (key: value).
